status: sealed before the run3 harvest (training outcome unseen except the in-training log and the iter-119 ad hoc probe recorded in note 2026-10-04e)

scope.question: does the FS1 co-trained defense (final checkpoint, deterministic actions) defend more often than the best scripted defense against adaptive attackers (attacker-pool snapshots and a fresh exploiter trained against it)
not_evidence_for: B0 v3 / P1 / P2 claims (new world, never pooled)

checkpoint: final ckpt.pt of the training run (total_steps >= 1.1e+08); no iteration selection

defenders.learned_det: ckpt defense team, deterministic (mean action, p>0.5 arm) - GATED
defenders.fin12: scripted: hold start station, finisher armed r_fire 12 m, limiters never armed
defenders.fin12_fb: fin12 + limiters armed after net spent (= training pool scripted_fin12)
defenders.kfirst50: fin12_fb + limiters armed when attacker within 50 m of asset (= training pool scripted_kfirst50)

opponent_groups.ladder: P1a ladder 24 configs, episode i uses config i mod 24 (10 each)
opponent_groups.rl_latest: final attacker team of the same ckpt (co-training partner) - reported only
opponent_groups.pool: 8 attacker-pool nn snapshots evenly spaced (np.linspace, rounded) over the final pool, episode i uses snapshot i mod 8 (30 each)
opponent_groups.ex_learned: fresh attacker trained from scratch against frozen learned_det only, 1e+07 env steps, seed 261100
opponent_groups.ex_kfirst50: fresh attacker trained from scratch against kfirst50 only, 1e+07 env steps, seed 261200
opponent_groups.attacker_actions: RL attackers act stochastically (as in training)

evaluation.paired: episode i of every group uses seed seed0 + i for every defender (identical placements)

invalid: paired: identical seed lists across defenders within each group
exploiter budget: both exploiter logs reach total_steps >= 1e+07
gate.classification: counts out of 240: D_pool = L(pool) - max_s S_s(pool); D_ex = L(ex_learned) - S_kfirst50(ex_kfirst50) (each defense vs its own exploiter, equal budget); D_ladder = L(ladder) - max_s S_s(ladder); L = learned_det defended, s over ['fin12', 'fin12_fb', 'kfirst50']. If D_pool >= +24 and D_ex >= +24: FS1_POSITIVE, relabelled FS1_POSITIVE_NARROW when D_ladder <= -24 (gain on adaptive attackers only; degeneration warning). Else FS1_NULL (this training seed).
reported_not_gated: net / K_FIRST / fallback / penetrated per cell
mode-rank reversal: K_FIRST share ladder vs adaptive groups (docs/123 section 7)
arm distance and fire distance medians

replication: run3 = training seed 0 -> provisional. Confirmed FS1_POSITIVE requires >= 2 of 3 training seeds {0, 1, 2} (same r3 design and budget) classified POSITIVE or POSITIVE_NARROW under this manifest; label NARROW if >= 2 of the passing seeds are NARROW.
